claims.quote: 17 females and 5 males with CDKL5 deficiency disorder (CDD)

claims.object_text: recognizable seizure semiology in first phase

claims.object_text: epileptic spasms present in >50% within first 2 months

claims.object_text: CDKL5 deficiency is a developmental and epileptic encephalopathy characterized by early, polymorphic, drug-resistant seizures
claims.quote: CDD is a true developmental and epileptic encephalopathy with a specific etiology characterized by the early appearance of epileptic seizures that quickly become polymorphic and drug resistant in infants that are most often female and already have neurological impairment.
